{{Top|leg}}
'''Emergency transponders''' were a type of [[Transponder (disambiguation)|transponder]]. A proposed modified version of the [[GV/3-series guardian droid]] designed for search and research work was intended to have an emergency transponder added as part of its equipment loadout.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
